items.name: FloatConfig
items.comment: Vertical motion applied to each timed word.

fields.name: enabled
fields.comment: Whether timed words float while they are sung.

fields.name: from
fields.comment: Starting vertical offset in logical pixels.

fields.name: to
fields.comment: Ending vertical offset in logical pixels.

items.name: MaskFeatherConfig
items.comment: Soft-edge sizing of the karaoke reveal mask.

fields.name: normal
fields.comment: Base feather width as a multiple of word height.

fields.name: first
fields.comment: Feather multiplier for the first word.

fields.name: last
fields.comment: Feather multiplier for the last word.

fields.name: enabled
fields.comment: Whether active words reveal progressively instead of switching immediately.

fields.name: feather
fields.comment: Soft-edge sizing of the reveal boundary.

items.name: EmphasizeMainConfig
items.comment: Core per-character transform of the emphasize effect: a scale pulse with an outward fan-out and an upward lift.

fields.name: enabled
fields.comment: Whether the main transform animation runs.

fields.name: scale
fields.comment: Peak scale increment; the character's peak scale is `1 + scale * intensity`, where the intensity derives from the syllable's duration.

fields.name: offsetHorizontal
fields.comment: Peak outward horizontal shift per character in logical pixels; characters fan out from the word's center.

fields.name: offsetVertical
fields.comment: Peak upward vertical shift in logical pixels, applied uniformly to every character.

fields.name: easingRise
fields.comment: Easing applied from rest to the peak at the pulse midpoint.

fields.name: easingFall
fields.comment: Easing applied from the peak back to rest.

items.name: EmphasizeGlowConfig
items.comment: Glow halo rendered behind emphasized characters; the only sub-effect that defaults to off because every character costs one blur per frame.

fields.name: enabled
fields.comment: Whether to render the glow.

fields.name: color
fields.comment: Glow color; an unparseable string silently disables the glow, acting as a soft kill switch.

fields.name: easingRise
fields.comment: Easing applied from rest to the peak at the pulse midpoint.

fields.name: easingFall
fields.comment: Easing applied from the peak back to rest.

fields.name: maxRadius
fields.comment: Maximum glow radius in logical pixels; the duration-derived intensity clamps it further so short syllables get a tighter halo.

fields.name: maxAlpha
fields.comment: Peak glow alpha in the `[0, 1]` range.

items.name: EmphasizeFloatDurationConfig
items.comment: Timing controls of the secondary float layer.

fields.name: scale
fields.comment: Float duration as a multiple of the main emphasize duration; values above 1 make the float linger after the main effect settles.

fields.name: lead
fields.comment: Milliseconds the float starts before the main emphasize effect.

items.name: EmphasizeFloatBackgroundConfig
items.comment: Amplified float for background lines, layered on the emphasize float.

fields.name: enabled
fields.comment: Whether background lines get an amplified float.

fields.name: scale
fields.comment: Float amplitude multiplier applied on background lines.

items.name: EmphasizeFloatConfig
items.comment: Secondary bounce layered on top of the per-word float animation.

fields.name: enabled
fields.comment: Whether to enable the secondary float.

fields.name: duration
fields.comment: Float timing.

fields.name: amplitude
fields.comment: Peak upward displacement in logical pixels.

fields.name: easing
fields.comment: Easing applied to each half of the bounce.

fields.name: background
fields.comment: Amplified float for background lines.

items.name: EmphasizeEffectsConfig
items.comment: Independently togglable sub-effects that compose the emphasize animation.

fields.name: main
fields.comment: Main per-character transform.

fields.name: glow
fields.comment: Glow halo.

fields.name: floating
fields.comment: Secondary float layer.

items.name: EmphasizeConfig
items.comment: Per-character emphasize effect of stressed syllables; at least one sub-effect must be enabled for the per-character split to happen.

fields.name: enabled
fields.comment: Master switch for the entire emphasize feature.

fields.name: effects
fields.comment: Sub-effects.

fields.name: minDuration
fields.comment: Minimum animation duration in milliseconds; shorter syllables still emphasize but their timeline lasts at least this long.

fields.name: disablePlaybackRate
fields.comment: Playback rate used to wind down an in-flight per-character animation when the line leaves the active state.

fields.name: floating
fields.comment: Vertical word motion.

fields.name: mask
fields.comment: Karaoke color reveal mask.

fields.name: emphasize
fields.comment: Per-character emphasize effect of stressed words.

items.name: WordConfig
items.comment: Rendering settings of each timed word.

fields.name: animation
fields.comment: Float and reveal animations of the word.

fields.name: font
fields.comment: Font of the karaoke main content; inherits the base line font when unset.

fields.name: style
fields.comment: Inactive, active, and played styles of the karaoke main content; inherit the base line styles when unset.

fields.name: word
fields.comment: Timed word rendering and animation settings.
